reviews.title: Short flight..on time
reviews.text: June 19, 2023 in morning; a short 50 min flight. A small local airline, using small propeller jets. Have a spotty reputation online as to timeliness, but our flight was absolutely on time. No reserved seating. Watch out for luggage weight limitations. Because of the many Fjords a return to Oslo by car or train takes much longer.
reviews.author: Andre D

reviews.title: AVOID (or at least read emails carefully)
reviews.text: I was signing on to write a cautionary review about my experience with an airport change (Heathrow to Stansted), and saw the top review was about the exact topic. And like the previous poster, I am not able to get a refund either, because the two-week notification window has closed. So I am having to buy entirely new tickets for my family, so we can make our transatlantic flight home. As I now see, Wideroe is a tiny airline, so sticking with SAS or Norwegian is a better idea.
reviews.author: Sarah B

reviews.title: Refund Policy
reviews.text: This is just a caution to all be really careful when updates to schedule are communicated. I booked LHR to Bergen return , and albeit I acknowledge a schedule change in Jan, I clocked this as a time change and missed actually the returning Airport had changed! from LHR to Stansted! When I did notice to late for refund, and zero flexibility. So was my first date with this airline and certainly my last and a costly and embarrassing mistake to boot !
reviews.author: Jon W

reviews.title: Worst experience in Europe
reviews.text: 3 hours of delay (and counting) without any explanation. Zero working staff at any of their gates. Totally a ghost airline. Don’t recommend under any circumstances.
reviews.author: Stan He

reviews.title: HORRIBLE!
reviews.text: Don’t ever fly with this company if you have other choices! I booked this because it was a direct flight. They changed my flight, without giving a reason, and had to stop in Copenhagen with a different airline. Once in Copenhagen, they cancelled my flight and had to stay 2 nights there. At the end, I found out that my original direct flight had landed in London according to plan!!!!!! They must have overbooked the flight and decided to change my booking, which I had booked with 5 months anticipation! I missed my weekend in London, I had everything booked and paid for!
reviews.author: Clau H

reviews.title: Cancel flights as they please without any explanation whatsoever
reviews.text: We were supposed to fly from Bergen to Tromsø.12h before our flight Widerøe just “canceled” the flight and we were moved to the next day. Later on we found out that the flight wasn’t canceled at all, they just overbooked it. I know this is standard practice for a lot of airlines, but the way Widerøe handled the situation was just extremely unprofessional. They should have been honest about the situation and they should have offered us to chose between boarding our booked flight or a fair compensation and a later flight (as other airlines do, for example Lufthansa). To bump passengers of a flight without any explanation or compensation offer the night before their scheduled flight is just unacceptable. So whatever you do DON’T FLY Widerøe.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.title: A seamless journey between Sandefjord-Torp and LHR
reviews.text: TRF-BGO-LHR. We flew from Sandefjord-Torp to London Heathrow with a change of aircraft in Bergen. The first flight was on Bombardier DHC-8-400 which was comfortable enough, they are very nice planes even with their rattles and vibrations. Transferring in Bergen was straightforward with a passport check before boarding the flight to LHR. The Embraer E190-E2 was used on the connecting flight which had reasonable seat pitch and comfortable seats. Beverages were brought round several times during the journey. Both flights were very good and the transfer at BGO was seamless.
reviews.author: Paul Legate

reviews.title: Appalling customer service
reviews.text: Wideroe moved my onward flight from Bergen to London to the following day - but the first leg remained on the original day. And then refused to pay for a hotel for the overnight layover in Bergen - behaviour that would not be lawful in the EU or UK. Avoid, avoid, avoid. Do anything you can to avoid relying on this airline.
reviews.author: nlgood

reviews.title: On time and decent service.
reviews.text: Flight was on time and the in-flight service was just ok. The old propeller planes are a bit annoying, but with good noice canceling headphones you will survive. Seats are hard and there is not much space.
reviews.author: Emil U

reviews.title: Refound not received
reviews.text: Avoid this airlines if you can, i was unable to travel so ticket was cancelled and NO refund received even though i bought cancelation policy!! the only received funds was 21£ god knows for what. They saying that you have right to cancel your flight with valid doctors apointment etc. but there was no such option at all. tried to phone customer service but they just hang out sending me to live chat and vice versa. They just don't want to give your money back and that's all. it is either - you going or not we got your money.. Obviously they will tell you that everything is in their policy etc. But the truth is nobody cares at all. Avoid this airline if you can, stick with SAS they got everything like should be.
reviews.author: Bioly B

reviews.title: They really don't care
reviews.text: I’m flying a lot these days, and Widerøe is by far one of the worst flight companies experience I've ever lived. I’ve always had bad experiences with Widerøe, but the last one was something even worse. I was travelling from Edinburgh to Ørsta-Volda Airport, and I did book my flight on Widerøe’s app a few weeks in advance. And they did announce the flight was cancelled only 2h before, excuse: “lack of crew.” They did reschedule us another flight later, but to Ålesund! Another destination, another company... Apart from this experience, the plane is extremely uncomfortable, the seats are also, the flight too… In short, I do not recommend Widerøe at all, and I find it wayyy too expensive for what it is in the end.
reviews.author: Chloé Urso

reviews.title: Damaged Luggage
reviews.text: I received my baggage full of oil because they broke a plastic bottle that was inside and properly protected. Now they say that it's my fault and they take no responsibility for it. It was the third fight that day and there was no problem on the other two. I don't recommend this company and won't fly with them again for sure.
reviews.author: MajoLui

reviews.title: Friendly
reviews.text: I use Widero quite a lot and they are a good company to fly with. The majority of the cabin crew are genuine and usually friendly. 99.9% of the time flights are bang on time sometimes ahead of schedule. The only very slight downside is the group boarding even on the short internal flights, I’ll be honest, is it really required. That’s my only moan, overall I like flying with them 👍🏼😊
reviews.author: s e an m

reviews.title: Terrible lack of professionalism - both a wideroe and a general problem with avinor
reviews.text: So I was flying back from Osaka to Trondheim through Dubai and Oslo. I was expecting to have to pick up my checked luggage at Oslo to then continue to Trondheim. It happens like this wirh mlat international flights to Norway. However, I was told and was even pointed to the avinor page about it that if flying from an international destination with emirates and then continuing with a set of airlines, including wideroe, domestically in Norway the luggage would be automatically transfered. I asked 4 times. I kept receiving the same response. One person told me no but then his supervisor told the other way around again.Also all the automatic checks worked. . Of course my luggage did not arrive to Trondheim. One person next to me flying from Dubai also had the same issue. It is really a joke with this lack of professionalism. It is to laugh about it if it is not about getting angry. They don't care for a good service. It is simply terrible.
reviews.author: Kostas A

reviews.title: Awful airline do not use
reviews.text: Cancelled 3 different flights in one day and wasted an entire day of our vacation. They gave us $15 to use on food for our troubles of waiting over 14 hours in an airport. Our original flight was supposed to be a direct 1.5 hour flight and we wasted an entire day. DONT USE
reviews.author: James W

reviews.title: Very helpful after KLM delayed my baggage
reviews.text: I flew with KLM who lost my baggage but Wideroe handled baggage claims at Trondheim. Their staff member MARKUS was really helpful and sorted out my claim..I got the baggage back the next day. A pleasure to meet such a calm and helpful member of staff in these difficult traveling times.
reviews.author: Robert W

reviews.title: Can't thank them enough
reviews.text: We flew with Wideroe from Bergen to Bodo on september 17 2022. Unfortunately, our first flight from Paris with Air France was delayed on short notice and we got very late at Bergen Airport. When we were in Paris, we tried to get help from Air France but since it was two different reservations, they told us they could absolutely do nothing for us. When we finally arrived at the check-in counter, it was 10min before departure. Initially they told us that we had to wait for another flight, but when we told them that it was 2 different reservations and that we would not get a replacement flight without paying, they took our luggage and told us to hurry through security. And thanks to them and the crew at Bergen Airport that day, we could make it just on time ! What a way to start a vacations ! Thank you so much Wideroe for letting us through, you saved us a lot of money and also our first days of travel in Norway !
reviews.author: Andrea

reviews.title: Basic Transportation
reviews.text: Flew on their largest aircraft, E190. Little legroom although I thought I opted for a better seat. On positive side the flight took off on time except for some ground hold caused by air traffic control.
reviews.author: Arnold P

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: Attention !! If your go to Norway, wideroe airline company is very very bad. There are often canceled flight and lost bagages. If you have time and money to waste, choose Wideroe.
reviews.author: Bastien B

reviews.title: Excellent on time and efficient
reviews.text: I had not heard of Widereo until July of this yeat 2022. I was a little skeptical reading negative reviews. Since Widereo was the only airline flying to Lofoten, I had no other choice. It turned out the flight was on time. There were only a few direct flights from Oslo to Svolvaer in a week. I happened to take one of them. The cost was not inexpensive for such a short flight. But the service was great. I also took another 45 minutes flight from Svolvaer to Bodo. The flight was not only on time but took off a little early as all passengers were on board. I had a great experience with Widereo. Thank you Widereo.
reviews.author: trang2010

reviews.title: Always always always always late
reviews.text: There is almost not a single time I’ve traveled with Widerøe that they have not been late. Every time I plan my trip, everything is ruined. When I ask friends or family to pick me up they always have to wait, ALWAYS. If someone like me like to plan their trip, pre ordering train or bus tickets before arriving on the destination airport is not a wise thing to do as you never know when you arrive. Widerøe is insanely expensive, and now they don’t even let you bring a cabin luggage with you if you get their cheapest option. You can’t earn EB points on domestic flights anymore either. Today I was going from Sandefjord to Trondheim. But instead of going directly, we had to stop in Bergen. Right now I was supposed to be in Trondheim, but I’m still in Bergen. Nightmare every time!
reviews.author: S R

reviews.title: Will rescedule your flights no info
reviews.text: Me and my boyfriend are very tired and disappointed in Wideroe. Because of the current strike a lot of flights are cancelled. We have been on edge this week wondering if our flight home to Gothenburg would get cancelled. Today however we had received no info about any cancellation so we went to the airport as regular. We were tense at the airport since we received no gates until 20 minutes or so before takeoff. Then the flight was delayed 1 hour so we waited. 10 minutes after the new later time for takeoff we were informed that the plane was too small to take all passengers so about 50% would get their flights rescheduled to the next day. We were one off those lucky 50%. We got very little info except that it would be a flight the next day. So we collected our bags. Turns out that the whole flight later got cancelled so the remaining passengers had their flight rescheduled as well but 30 minutes later. We were told we would get a new flight but that flight would take 8 hours instead of our original flight's time of 1 hour. This because we would hav to change flight in Stavanger, Trondheim and Copenhagen (a Scandinavian tour one might say). Needless to say me and my boyfriend don't trust this company and will take the train instead tomorrow. One more thing we were promised a night on a hotell because our flight leaves tomorrow. We have not been given that yet and we have waited almost 4 hours. It is 21.46 local time... we will sleep at a friend but there were others at the air
reviews.author: Rebecka I

reviews.title: Poor service after cancelled flights
reviews.text: Today 26th June we were sat on the afternoon flight to Aberdeen. The plane developed a technical fault with its radar beacon and the flight was cancelled, so we were all taken off the plane and taken back through customs to get our bags back. The only advice from Widerøe check in desk was try to rebook yourself a flight back home and we’ll refund your ticket. No assistance to get flights rebooked, no assistance with accommodation, no assistance to get to accommodation. So to get back to Aberdeen with two disabled members in my party I’ve had to book a direct flight to Newcastle in 2 days and get a hire car from Newcastle to Aberdeen airport. Not impressed by the Widerøe support.
reviews.author: Malcolm m

reviews.title: Bad communication and customer servics
reviews.text: We are first time Wideroe fliers and are disappointed in our experience (writing this as we wait 6 hours for our changed connection flight). We were impressed with the sensible cost to fly between Norwegian cities, and thought we'd have plenty of time to transfer planes in the small Bodo airport. We would have, if our original flight hadn't been delayed by almost 2 hours. The departures board and Wideroe website remained showing the original departure time of 12:30pm until it finally left at 2:00pm, with only the occasional verbal updates at the gate about delays; meanwhile, the destination airport was showing the delay undee its departures website. We missed our connecting flight to Leknes, and after being told we'd be put up in a hotel overnight in Bodo and flown out tomorrow we were automatically booked to another town late this evening (Svolvaer), with no warning, just receiving an email. Our car rental is in Leknes and no cars available in Svolvaer, plus we land too late at night to travel to Leknes to get the car and drive down to Reine as planned. So now we are paying for a hotel stay in Svolvaer, a 1 hr. 22 min. bus ride to Leknes, and missing out on a day of our car rental and expensive rorbuer stay in Reine. No apology from Wideroe or offer of refund of any type. I'm glad we'll eventually get to our destination but it will have taken us 24 hours for a trip that was originally 3 hours long, plus additional costs. Dreading our return flight to Oslo in a few days. The
reviews.author: SaEofDoom

reviews.title: Unpalatable
reviews.text: Arriving at 5h15 am, the airport opened at 5h30.. The check-in started at 6h55/7h for a 7h25 departure (originally 6h45 departure) when reaching my turn, i got told i had been moved onto the next flight that was 3 hours later (9h40, without having been told beforehand and the sole customer from the said flight.. I had bought my tickets 1 month in advance).. Nonetheless i had to oblige despite my travel having been planned to the dot (5 planes in total for a 1 and a half day journey). As for the air hostess, unpleasant and nearly robotic. Wideroe, no no (no more)!!!
reviews.author: Isaac B

reviews.title: Shocking Customer Service. I would never use them again!
reviews.text: The worst airline I have ever had the misfortune to use. Delayed due to their own inefficiency and took over 27 hours to get to Tromso. No communication or apology and their customer service couldn’t care less. 12 weeks later and still waiting for compensation.
reviews.author: SJB2430

reviews.title: Excellent pilots, terrible customer service
reviews.text: I've been flying back and forth now several times with Widerøe. Pilots are reliable and highly skilled in these harsh weather conditions. Customer service at both airports unfortunately is terrible with one exception (a nice blonde girl in Hammerfest, you actually smiled and we're professional, thank you for that!) Most times customers are made to wait and I really wish that Hammerfest airport soon gets a self-service bag drop station. In Tromsø airport with a lost luggage I felt like a plague patient at a germophobic convention. SAS customer service saved me that time, thank you! Stewardesses mostly are nice, thank you also!
reviews.author: Sirpa L

reviews.title: Excellent landing at Vagar aiport/Faroe Islands   under extremely strong wind
reviews.text: I dislike to fly small planes, but if I want to go to places like Faroe Islands I do not have other choice than flying Wideroe, - and I have some landings in Brønnøysund which have not been too pleasant. So I was really worried when we were going to fly to Faroe Islands on a day with extremely strong wind. But the whole flight was very nice, and I am really impressed by the landing,
reviews.author: Ingeborg56

reviews.title: Skilled pilots, poor airport service
reviews.text: Several visits to Hammerfest Airport. Sorry to say that arrogant and unfriendly "service" was more of a rule than exception. Happy to say that the pilots really know their business! Flights even though really rough weather feel safe and surprisingly smooth in the small aircrafts.
reviews.author: Sirpa L

reviews.title: Totally worthless company!😡
reviews.text: Flying with widerøe is not i will recommend to anybody! They are almost everytime late in schedule and they never compensate the passengers for this. The service is lousy and the personal not very serviceminded! Just knowing that if you fly in business class, you shold’nt dream of a free cup of coffe or anything that will make the trip nicer!😡👎 I ALWAYS FLY IN BUSINESS CLASS
reviews.author: TrailBlazer298921
